coordinateSystem: Original body-fixed radar-model Cartesian axes; positive Z is the selected spin pole; east-positive longitude; arbitrary display phase
source: Magri et al. (2011), Icarus 214, 210–227; Arecibo radar, optical lightcurves and NASA/JPL shape archive: ecliptic J2000 lambda 281 deg, beta -31 deg, period 8.76243 h; equatorial conversion uses J2000 obliquity 23.439291111 deg. The narrow neck and two lobes are constrained by radar and lightcurves, while weakly observed regions and facet-scale detail remain model-dependent. The published pole is uncertain by 5 degrees and the equivalent diameter by 8%. No resolved optical surface map is supplied.
